title: Glossier You Doux Eau de Parfum Travel Spray

specifications.Breadcrumbs: Travel Size & Mini Cologne > Men > Fragrance

descriptionHtml:
✓ Woody & Earthy Scent✓ Unisex/Genderless Scent✓ Layerable Scent
Fragrance Family: Earthy & Woody

Scent Type: Warm Woods

Key Notes: Sweet Violet, Palo Santo, Ambrox

Fragrance Description: Glossier You Doux is a soft, skin-scent-enhancing, woody fragrance that opens with sweet violet followed by a precious blend of woody palo santo, frankincense, and smoky myrrh—heightened by a warm, musky base driven by ambrox.

About the Bottle: The bottle is an objet d’art in its own right. It is crafted in house at Glossier; it has the real thumbprint indent of the designer. So just like the scent, the bottle of Glossier You Doux is unfinished. It needs you to hold it to complete it.

About the Fragrance: Impressions of You are not scents you wear to become someone e
How to Use+
Suggested Usage:
-Spray scent as desired on your pulse points: your neck, behind your ears, your wrists, and more.
-Allow fragrance to settle for a few moments rather than rubbing it in as this can disrupt the scent.
-Apply post-shower and after moisturizing to aid absorption for a longer, stronger scent impact.
Ingredients+
Alcohol Denat., Fragrance/Parfum, Water/Aqua/Eau, Tetramethyl Acetyloctahydronaphthalenes, Juniperus Virginiana Oil, Hydroxycitronellal, Trimethylcyclopentenyl Methylisopentenol, Beta-Caryophyllene, Pinene, Vanillin, Eugenol, Limonene, Hexadecanolactone.
